bugs.error_message: Type error: Property 'subtotal' does not exist on type 'Cart & { __applicationErrorsType?: GetCurrentCartApplicationErrors | undefined; }'.
bugs.root_cause: The raw getCurrentCart() response from @wix/ecom does NOT have a top-level `subtotal` field. That `subtotal` property exists on the higher-level @wix/headless-ecom Cart abstraction (a wrapper component library), NOT the bare cart object returned by currentCart.getCurrentCart().
bugs.fix: Compute subtotal client-side from line items: `lineItems.reduce((sum, item) => sum + parseFloat(item.price?.amount ?? '0') * (item.quantity ?? 0), 0)`, then format with `new Intl.NumberFormat('en-NZ', { style: 'currency', currency: cart?.currency ?? 'NZD' })`. This is a numerical approximation that matches Wix's subtotal except in cases with cart-level discounts (acceptable for v1; Wix re-computes on the hosted checkout).
